is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. laboratory strains (Page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Mentions target markers Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) present in introgressed laboratory strains (Page 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype counts or frequencies for field mosquito populations are reported in the study.

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes studied were strictly laboratory colony strains (Kisumu, Acerkis, and Kdrkis). No field-collected mosquitoes were genotyped (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study evaluating Plasmodium falciparum infection outcome in Anopheles gambiae strains (Page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: Blood isolates for P. falciparum were collected from children in Dandé and Soumousso, Burkina Faso (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Specific collection years for the field parasite isolates or experimental infection period are not explicitly stated.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Study uses standard laboratory mosquito strains.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files needed since no field mosquito genotype data were collected.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated vector competence for field P. falciparum isolates using three Anopheles gambiae laboratory strains (Kisumu, Acerkis, and Kdrkis). Because no field-collected mosquito populations were genotyped and only laboratory colony strains were used, the paper does not meet the eligibility criteria.
exclusion_reasons: african_field_population: Mosquitoes genotyped/tested were strictly laboratory colony strains (Kisumu, Acerkis, Kdrkis); no field-collected African mosquito populations were genotyped.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No extractable genotype counts or frequencies for field-collected mosquito populations are reported.
